entries.title: Numbers 33:1
segments: ¶These [are] the journeys of the children of Israel, who went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

entries.title: Numbers 33:2
segments: Now Moses wrote down the starting points of their journeys at the command of the LORD. And these [are] their journeys according to their starting points:

entries.title: Numbers 33:3
segments: They departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out with boldness in the sight of all the Egyptians.

entries.title: Numbers 33:4
segments: For the Egyptians were burying all [their] firstborn, whom the LORD had killed among them. Also on their gods the LORD had executed judgments.

entries.title: Numbers 33:5
segments: Then the children of Israel moved from Rameses and camped at Succoth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:6
segments: They departed from Succoth and camped at Etham, which [is] on the edge of the wilderness.

entries.title: Numbers 33:7
segments: They moved from Etham and turned back to Pi Hahiroth, which [is] east of Baal Zephon; and they camped near Migdol.

entries.title: Numbers 33:8
segments: They departed from before Hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, went three days' journey in the Wilderness of Etham, and camped at Marah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:9
segments: They moved from Marah and came to Elim. At Elim [were] twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; so they camped there.

entries.title: Numbers 33:10
segments: They moved from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

entries.title: Numbers 33:11
segments: They moved from the Red Sea and camped in the Wilderness of Sin.

entries.title: Numbers 33:12
segments: They journeyed from the Wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:13
segments: They departed from Dophkah and camped at Alush.

entries.title: Numbers 33:14
segments: They moved from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

entries.title: Numbers 33:15
segments: They departed from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.

entries.title: Numbers 33:16
segments: They moved from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:17
segments: They departed from Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:18
segments: They departed from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:19
segments: They departed from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.

entries.title: Numbers 33:20
segments: They departed from Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:21
segments: They moved from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:22
segments: They journeyed from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:23
segments: They went from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

entries.title: Numbers 33:24
segments: They moved from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:25
segments: They moved from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:26
segments: They moved from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

entries.title: Numbers 33:27
segments: They departed from Tahath and camped at Terah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:28
segments: They moved from Terah and camped at Mithkah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:29
segments: They went from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:30
segments: They departed from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:31
segments: They departed from Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.

entries.title: Numbers 33:32
segments: They moved from Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Hagidgad.

entries.title: Numbers 33:33
segments: They went from Hor Hagidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:34
segments: They moved from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:35
segments: They departed from Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.

entries.title: Numbers 33:36
segments: They moved from Ezion Geber and camped in the Wilderness of Zin, which [is] Kadesh.

entries.title: Numbers 33:37
segments: They moved from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the boundary of the land of Edom.

entries.title: Numbers 33:38
segments: Then Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the LORD, and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first [day] of the fifth month.

entries.title: Numbers 33:39
segments: Aaron [was] one hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.

entries.title: Numbers 33:40
segments: Now the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 33:41
segments: So they departed from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:42
segments: They departed from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

entries.title: Numbers 33:43
segments: They departed from Punon and camped at Oboth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:44
segments: They departed from Oboth and camped at Ije Abarim, at the border of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:45
segments: They departed from Ijim and camped at Dibon Gad.

entries.title: Numbers 33:46
segments: They moved from Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.

entries.title: Numbers 33:47
segments: They moved from Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

entries.title: Numbers 33:48
segments: They departed from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, [across from] Jericho.

entries.title: Numbers 33:49
segments: They camped by the Jordan, from Beth Jesimoth as far as the Abel Acacia Grove in the plains of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:50
segments: ¶Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, [across from] Jericho, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 33:51
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When you have crossed the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

entries.title: Numbers 33:52
segments: 'then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their engraved stones, destroy all their molded images, and demolish all their high places;

entries.title: Numbers 33:53
segments: 'you shall dispossess [the inhabitants of] the land and dwell in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

entries.title: Numbers 33:54
segments: 'And you shall divide the land by lot as an inheritance among your families; to the larger you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance; there everyone's [inheritance] shall be whatever falls to him by lot. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

entries.title: Numbers 33:55
segments: 'But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it shall be that those whom you let remain [shall be] irritants in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land where you dwell.

entries.title: Numbers 33:56
segments: 'Moreover it shall be [that] I will do to you as I thought to do to them.'"
